attempts.summary: Brought node1's previously-unconfigured lan-b-facing interface (vtnet2) into service as a new OPNsense zone ("optb"/LANB, 172.31.98.1/24) via config.xml + configctl reconfigure, added a firewall pass rule for the zone, and gave node3's matching interface (enp8s0) a persistent static address (172.31.98.2/24) via its existing NetworkManager profile. Verified node3 reaches node1 on lan-b and reaches node2 (10.100.55.11, lan-a) with the traffic actually routed/forwarded through node1 (confirmed via forced host route + TTL decrement + tcpdump on both of node1's interfaces). Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes with boot-identity proof and post-restart recovery verification, including confirming the new OPNsense zone and firewall rule persisted across node1's reboot.
